reason: I put the same amount into index funds every month for free and barely look at it, so I don't need an AI pet doing it for me. I'm not paying a monthly fee to invest when what I have now already works.
objection: With under $20k invested, any monthly subscription eats into my returns, and I don't want an app making moves with my money that I'd then have to keep an eye on.
would_change_my_mind: If it were free or cost nothing beyond what my broker already charges, and it clearly did better than my plain monthly index fund buys.
